work.author: PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA
work.description: The act announces the Spanish concordat and the articles agreed with Tuscany. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF33-37) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF10551-10552 reads: HABITA 1N CONSISTORIO SECRETO DIE V SEPTEMBRIS ANNO MDCCCLI Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
